legend.head: what the board’s colours and marks mean
legend.row.0: your move · agent working · with the reviewers · nothing waiting, or a move of yours that can wait
legend.row.1: you are the hold-up · yours whenever you like · red: what is waiting on you is broken
legend.row.2: not flagged · flagged important by you, in this browser only; its row leads its group
legend.row.3: the state and its age · green: already on a shared branch
legend.row.4: already deployed — press again for what came after
legend.row.5: the ticket · the request and how long it has been open · green ✓: approved
legend.row.6: its checks: failed · passed · still running, or a retry pending. No dot: no pipeline, or nothing read it
legend.row.7: where the board names projects, the name opens its request; across repositories, each name its own · ✓ approved
legend.row.8: replies were drafted since you last opened this tab — read them before you ship
legend.row.9: in a round’s replies: the verdict — green fixed · amber a question · grey pushed back — and the comment it answers
legend.row.10: stopped, yours to restart: nothing will look at this round again on its own, the state wearing it where no request is linked · in the header, the Master only judges until you press it
legend.row.11: the card’s own line: broken · your move
legend.row.12: in the list: the tasks waiting on you, above the rest
legend.row.13: in the list: bold, its state moved since you last had it open
legend.row.14: in a plan: bold with a bar, new or changed since the plan you last approved · struck through, removed since
legend.row.15: on a row: its most pressed verb, without opening the task · filled where that verb is your move
legend.row.16: a verb’s key, drawn after its name · Done muted at the row’s end until hovered
legend.row.17: in the jobs: the last run failed, its age in red · its dot and a path check’s are the checks dot
legend.row.18: a verb’s answer, passing: it ran · it was refused
legend.row.19: the tab’s title: how many tasks wait on you; its icon wears an amber dot, or red when something broke
legend.row.20: in the header: how many cards are an interruption
legend.row.21: in the header: nothing polls the requests · a job whose last run failed, pressed for the jobs · the Master presses the buttons you would
legend.row.22: in the header: this page is cut off from the backend, and nothing on it can run · the model provider failed repeatedly, so headless reads wait for one probe · jagt cannot reach a code host, pressed to log in, no card stops
legend.row.23: in the header: the gear opens the settings · the theme, auto following the system, and the language, kept in this browser alone
